name: Priestly Training Room
desc1: The hall's lofty roof is supported by graceful soaring archways, and
desc2: the walls are crafted of white marble run through with silver streaks.
desc3: A priest looks up as you enter, nodding gently to you. There are many
desc4: thick and elaborately-worked tomes covering the table she sits at;
desc5: one of these she closes as you approach. She fairly radiates calm and
desc6: quiet confidence, and she obviously is quite strong in her faith. To
desc7: the north is the magnificent temple hall.
